mainEntity.name: What is the most recent AI model release?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most recent tracked release is Anthropic Claude Haiku 5.5, released Oct 7, 2026. Anthropic's new small, fast model and the last of the 5.5 family, built for high-volume work like summaries, classification and live customer support, and costing far less than Haiku 4.5. It's the first Haiku with an adjustable effort setting, and it can act as a cheap helper agent alongside Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5.

mainEntity.name: What is the latest AI model from OpenAI?

acceptedAnswer.text: The latest OpenAI release in this tracker is GPT-6 & Intelligent UI in ChatGPT (All Users), released Oct 7, 2026. GPT-6 is now the default in ChatGPT chat for everyone, with paid plans on GPT-6 Sol and Free and Go users on GPT-6 Luna. A new Intelligent UI lets answers mix text with charts, maps, buttons, forms and small on-the-spot tools like calculators, and web-search answers start noticeably faster.

mainEntity.name: What is the latest AI model from Google?

acceptedAnswer.text: The latest Google release in this tracker is Gemini Nano Banana 2.1, released Oct 6, 2026. An updated version of Google's fast image generation and editing model, with better image quality, closer prompt following and cleaner text inside images at the same speed and cost. It's now generally available in the Gemini API and replaces Nano Banana 2.

mainEntity.name: What is the latest AI model from Meta?

acceptedAnswer.text: The latest Meta release in this tracker is Muse Spark 1.3, released Sep 2, 2026. Meta Superintelligence Labs' updated frontier model for coding and long-running agent work, now in Muse Code and Meta's API. The notable change is behavioral: it asks clarifying questions when a prompt is ambiguous, pulls the user in when it gets stuck, and checks before taking consequential actions — while using fewer tool calls and tokens than 1.2.

mainEntity.name: What is the latest AI model from DeepSeek?

acceptedAnswer.text: The latest DeepSeek release in this tracker is DeepSeek V4-Pro (0813 Official Release), released Aug 12, 2026. DeepSeek's flagship V4-Pro model graduated from preview to full production after a nearly four-month preview period, with no changes to API pricing or integration for existing users.

acceptedAnswer.text: The tracker currently covers 140 model releases and AI-search updates from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, and DeepSeek.
